data.narrative:
Antora Energy is a Series C climate and energy company that has raised $550M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-stage, same-sector comparables in the Climate & Energy space: KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M). The broader comp universe includes one public company and eight private peers, spanning advanced materials and alternative energy solutions.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $550M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $935M. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of the three same-stage, same-sector comparables at $1.0B, with a stated range of $700M to $3.0B reflecting the dispersion within the peer set.

These methods triangulate to a range of $795M to $1.1B, with a median implied valuation of $968M. The width of the peer range—driven primarily by KoBold Metals' outlier $3.0B valuation—reflects material uncertainty around technology maturity, capital intensity, and path to cash generation within the frontier climate tech sector. Key sensitivities include the relative progress of Antora's core technology, competitive positioning against the peer set, and near-term funding and deployment milestones.
